items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Glenn Miller had called me, and wanted to hire me... would I like to come with his band... he had hired Maurice Purtle to play drums

ctx.x: But I was very ill for several months, four or five months. Glenn Miller had called me, and wanted to hire me. He wanted to lead -- Glen / Island Casino, Glenn Miller. He had borrowed money from Sy Schribner man in Boston.
